item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary: Establish the Python project and parser stage interfaces.
type: foundational
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: ARCHITECTURE.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: parser foundation
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python project, environment, dependency manifest, lockfile, and test runner
  described by the technology stack. Define the document tree and interfaces for block parsing,
  document-wide reference definitions, inline parsing, and HTML rendering. The block phase
  precedes the inline phase. Use the standard library and do not use a public Markdown
  implementation. Keep the supplied conformance assets read-only.

## story cli
summary: Provide the root executable and standard streams interface.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-CommandLine.md
covers: DELIVERY-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: commonmark
consumes: parser foundation
depends: foundation
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Provide executable ./commonmark at the application root. Read UTF-8 Markdown from standard
  input and write rendered HTML to standard output. Connect the parser stages as they become
  available. Establish the executable interface before scoped conformance checks.

## story paragraphs
summary: Parse paragraphs, blank lines, and thematic breaks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ParagraphsAndBreaks.md
covers: BLOCK-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: paragraph and thematic break blocks
consumes: parser foundation, commonmark
depends: foundation, cli
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement paragraph accumulation, blank-line handling, and thematic-break recognition and
  precedence as specified. Preserve raw inline content for the later inline phase. Account for
  tab stops, line endings, replacement of null characters, and ordinary textual content.
  Bind scoped acceptance to the relevant owning specification sections; defer examples requiring
  later constructs to the integration checks that own those constructs.

## story headings
summary: Parse ATX and setext headings.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Headings.md
covers: BLOCK-002
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: heading blocks
consumes: paragraph and thematic break blocks
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement ATX opening and optional closing markers and setext underlines, including indentation,
  interruption, and precedence rules. Preserve heading content for inline parsing. Exercise the
  complete applicable heading sections after their required inline behavior is available.

## story code-blocks
summary: Parse indented and fenced code blocks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-CodeBlocks.md
covers: BLOCK-003
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: code blocks
consumes: paragraph and thematic break blocks
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement indented and fenced code blocks, their interruption and indentation rules, literal
  content, matching fences, and info strings. Preserve literal code rather than parsing it as
  inline Markdown. Exercise applicable scoped examples and retain cross-feature examples for
  subsequent integration.

## story html-blocks
summary: Parse the seven types of HTML blocks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-HtmlBlocks.md
covers: BLOCK-004
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: HTML blocks
consumes: paragraph and thematic break blocks
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement all seven HTML block start and termination conditions, paragraph interruption,
  container boundaries, and verbatim rendering. Exercise the applicable HTML block examples,
  including interaction examples when their other constructs are available.

## story references
summary: Collect document-wide link reference definitions.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ReferenceDefinitions.md
covers: BLOCK-005
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: reference definition map
consumes: paragraph and thematic break blocks
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Detect definitions when closing paragraphs, including definitions inside containers. Normalize
  labels using Unicode case folding and whitespace rules, retain the first matching definition,
  and expose the document-wide map to inline parsing. Keep any remaining paragraph content.
  Verify definition collection directly until reference links are implemented, then cover the
  full reference-definition corpus in the relevant later integration.

## story block-quotes
summary: Parse nested block quotes and lazy continuations.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-BlockQuotes.md
covers: BLOCK-006
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: block quote containers
consumes: paragraph and thematic break blocks, heading blocks, code blocks, HTML blocks, reference definition map
depends: headings, code-blocks, html-blocks, references
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement block quote markers, continuation matching, laziness, separation, and nested block
  content according to the block parsing strategy. Preserve document-wide reference collection.
  Exercise the applicable block quote examples and defer examples requiring lists or later inline
  features to their owning integration checks.

## story lists
summary: Parse list items and lists with nesting and tightness.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Lists.md
covers: BLOCK-007
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: list containers
consumes: block quote containers, reference definition map, heading blocks, code blocks, HTML blocks
depends: block-quotes, references, headings, code-blocks, html-blocks
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement list markers, item indentation, continuation, laziness, nested containers, empty
  items, ordered starts, and tight or loose rendering. Follow the specification's block-tree
  algorithm and precedence rules. Exercise the List items and Lists sections when their inline
  prerequisites are available; retain cross-feature coverage in later integration.

## story escapes
summary: Parse backslash escapes and character references.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-EscapesAndEntities.md
covers: INLINE-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline escapes and character references
consumes: list containers, reference definition map
depends: lists
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement ASCII punctuation escapes and valid HTML5 named and numeric character references,
  including their context restrictions and invalid-code-point handling. Parse inline content only
  after block structure and the reference map are complete. Exercise the owning specification
  sections with cross-feature examples assigned to the later integration that supplies them.

## story code-spans
summary: Parse and normalize backtick code spans.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-CodeSpans.md
covers: INLINE-002
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: code spans
consumes: inline escapes and character references
depends: escapes
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Match equal-length backtick runs, normalize line endings and surrounding spaces as specified,
  and render literal escaped code content. Preserve precedence with other inline constructs.
  Exercise the Code spans section with cross-feature examples covered once their prerequisites exist.

## story emphasis
summary: Resolve emphasis and strong emphasis.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Emphasis.md
covers: INLINE-003
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: emphasis and strong emphasis
consumes: code spans, inline escapes and character references
depends: code-spans
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement delimiter-run classification and the specification's delimiter-stack algorithm,
  including flanking, Unicode punctuation and whitespace, the multiple-of-three rule, nesting,
  and precedence. Cover the emphasis section and retain examples involving later links, images,
  autolinks, or raw HTML for their integration.

## story links
summary: Parse inline and reference links.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Links.md
covers: INLINE-004
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline and reference links
consumes: reference definition map, emphasis and strong emphasis, code spans
depends: emphasis, references
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement inline, full, collapsed, and shortcut links, including destination and title grammar,
  label matching, precedence, and the prohibition on nested links. Use the completed reference
  map and the specification's bracket and delimiter-stack procedure. Exercise the Links and
  Link reference definitions sections, assigning image-dependent examples to the image integration.

## story images
summary: Parse inline and reference images.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Images.md
covers: INLINE-005
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline and reference images
consumes: inline and reference links, reference definition map
depends: links
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement inline and reference image forms using the shared link grammar and reference map.
  Render the plain textual content of the image description as escaped alt text, preserving
  nesting and precedence rules. Exercise the Images section and link and reference examples that
  require images.

## story autolinks-html
summary: Parse autolinks and raw inline HTML.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-AutolinksAndRawHtml.md
covers: INLINE-006
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: autolinks and raw inline HTML
consumes: inline and reference images, code spans
depends: images
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement URI and email autolinks and the specified inline HTML grammar, preserving raw HTML
  and applying URL and attribute escaping as required by the examples. Exercise Autolinks and
  Raw HTML, along with earlier precedence examples that require these constructs.

## story line-breaks
summary: Parse hard and soft inline line breaks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-InlineLineBreaks.md
covers: INLINE-007
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline line breaks
consumes: autolinks and raw inline HTML, emphasis and strong emphasis
depends: autolinks-html
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement hard and soft breaks, including trailing-space and backslash forms, block-end rules,
  whitespace handling, and code-span and HTML exclusions. Exercise the owning sections and
  previously deferred cross-feature conformance examples now that all parser capabilities exist.

## story documentation
summary: Document the standard-stream command interface.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Documentation.md
covers: DELIVERY-002
stack: common.md, python.md
consumes: commonmark
depends: cli
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Create a concise application README describing invocation of ./commonmark and its UTF-8
  standard-input and HTML standard-output interface. Verify the delivered documentation through
  a suitable executable acceptance check without modifying conformance assets.

## story verification
summary: Verify the complete supplied conformance suite.
type: service
kind: test harness
phase: 2
implements: VERIFICATION.md
covers: DELIVERY-003
accepts: st-001
stack: common.md, python.md
consumes: commonmark, inline line breaks
depends: line-breaks, documentation, cli, paragraphs, headings, code-blocks, html-blocks, references, block-quotes, lists, escapes, code-spans, emphasis, links, images, autolinks-html
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Run the sole terminal Suite: full acceptance using sh sources/full_test.sh from the application
  root. Print captured stdout and stderr and assert only that the process return code is zero.
  Use the supplied unfiltered assets verbatim; do not alter the harness or its entry point.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
